# IAD Airport Limo

> Licensed and insured luxury chauffeur service for Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), with additional coverage of Reagan National (DCA) and BWI. Flat-rate pricing, real-time flight tracking, and 24/7 availability across Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

## Services

- Dulles (IAD) airport transfers with real-time flight tracking
- Personal chauffeur service — appointments, shopping, nights out
- Corporate transportation with monthly account billing
- Wedding, birthday, and prom limousine service
- Event and concert transportation
- Wine tour transportation across Loudoun County and Northern Virginia
- Hourly, as-directed chauffeur service

## Fleet

- Business Sedan: Mercedes-Benz E-Class (3 passengers)
- First Class Sedan: BMW 7 Series, Mercedes-Benz S-Class (3 passengers)
- Midsize SUV: Lincoln Nautilus (3 passengers)
- Luxury SUV: Chevrolet Suburban (5 passengers)
- Premium SUV: Cadillac Escalade (6 passengers)
- Sprinter Shuttle, Sprinter Executive, Sprinter Limo (13 passengers)
- Mini Coach and Party Bus for larger groups

## Service Areas

Washington DC, Northern Virginia (Loudoun, Fairfax, Prince William, Arlington), Maryland
